name: MissNoMore
description: MissNoMore is a Python-based missing value imputation tool designed to handle CSV datasets with missing data.

paragraphs: MissNoMore is a Python-based missing value imputation tool designed to handle CSV datasets with missing data. It offers a range of imputation techniques, from simple mean and median strategies to more advanced methods like K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), iterative imputation, and decision tree-based imputations. The tool provides both a "Basic" mode for quick imputations and an "Advanced" mode for more sophisticated approaches.
features: Missing value imputation for CSV datasets
Two modes: "Basic" (mean, median, interpolate) and "Advanced" (KNN, iterative, decision tree)
Leveraging the power of Pandas for data manipulation
Improves data quality by handling missing data effectively
